newsitem.title: CROATIA: Zagrebacka group '96 pre-tax HRK349 mln vs 95 loss.
newsitem.headline: Zagrebacka group '96 pre-tax HRK349 mln vs 95 loss.

text.p: Croatian Zagrebacka Banka group said on Tuesday it posted a profit of 349 million kuna before taxation in 1996, compared to a 143 million loss a year earlier.
The parent bank's pre-tax profit rose to 266 million kuna from 162 million in 1995, it said in a statement faxed to Reuters.
Zagrebacka gave no figure for 1996 net earnings. The group made a 184.3 million kuna loss in 1995 after tax and minority interests.
The group's balance sheet grew some 18 percent last year from roughly 17.1 billion kuna at the end of 1995.
The bank's balance sheet growth was slightly lower at 16 percent from 16.2 billion in 1995.
The group includes Zagrebacka Banka d.d., a holding company that comprises its interests in the tourist industry, Pomorska Banka and Adriatic Osiguranje insurance firm.
